name: net_principal_movement
definition: Net signed principal movement per loan account per calendar month
numerator: sum(event_amount) over in-scope DISBURSEMENT and PRINCIPAL_REPAYMENT events after matched-pair reversal removal
time_basis: event effective date grouped by calendar month
exclusions: fee events; reversed principal events and their reversal rows; events after the cutoff

name: principal_event_count
definition: Count of in-scope principal events per loan account per calendar month
numerator: count of in-scope principal event rows after dedup and matched-pair reversal removal
time_basis: event effective date grouped by calendar month
exclusions: fee events; reversed principal events and their reversal rows; events after the cutoff
